settings_port: {name} is "{value}", which is not a port number.
settings_reserved: {name} is {port}: Cleared never binds {reserved}. Choose another port.
settings_same: {name} and {other} are both {port}: give each its own port.
settings_state: CLEARED_V2_STATE_DIR is "{value}": it must be an absolute path other than /, with no colon and no space.
settings_project: The Compose project name "{value}" is refused: lower-case letters, digits, dashes and underscores, starting with a letter or a digit.
docker_missing: Docker does not answer here: {reason}. Install Docker Engine, let this account use it, then run the command again.
ports_unreadable: The listening ports of this machine cannot be read, so no port can be shown to be free.
port_held: {name} is {port}, and {address}:{port} is already in use on this machine. Free it, or run the command again with {name} set to a free port.
clone_unreadable: The clone at {path} cannot be read, so its owner is not known.
clone_root: The clone belongs to root, and Cleared would run its sessions as root. Clone the repository as your own account and run the command from there.
state_not_folder: {path} is not a folder: CLEARED_V2_STATE_DIR must name a folder.
state_other: The state folder {path} belongs to uid {uid}, not to the owner of the clone (uid {owner}).
state_open: Other accounts may write in the state folder {path} (mode {mode}). Run chmod go-w {path}, then the command again.
images_build: Building the session images ({names}), once per machine.
starting: Starting Cleared ({project}). The first build of its image takes a few minutes.
start_failed: Docker Compose could not start Cleared: {reason}
no_answer: Cleared does not answer on {address} after {duration}. See what it says: docker compose --project-name {project} -f v2/compose.yaml logs app service
already: Cleared already runs ({project}) on {address}: nothing was changed.
open_next: Open that address in a browser on this machine. From another computer, forward the port over SSH first: ssh -L {port}:127.0.0.1:{port} <this machine>
mount_folder_left: Docker made the empty folder {path} to mount it in the install. The next run takes it as it is.
